items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Quiet before potential trade
items.text:
Taylor rushed 13 times for 46 yards and brought in all five targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Blake Corum: Hits paydirt against Washington
items.text:
Corum carried the ball 11 times for 58 yards and a touchdown and failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders.

items.title: Dak Prescott: Another 300-yard tally in win
items.text:
Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for one yard in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Just one TD in Week 9 win
items.text:
Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders. He added one yard on his only carry.

items.title: Javonte Williams: Eclipses century mark in win
items.text:
Williams rushed 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 23 yards in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday.
